annotations.title: Ask a short question through Sess

examples.details: I will check the forecast and suggest a plan.
examples.question: Where should we go on Saturday?

details.description: A paragraph of plain text (never markup): what the person needs to know; at most 4000.
examples: The refund goes back to the card used for the order.

expires_in.description: Advanced: how long the link stays open, in whole seconds from creation: from 30 up to the plan’s link lifetime. Leave it out to use the plan’s lifetime.

default.description: Proposed value the person can correct.

high.description: Optional words at one end of a rating, shown by its lowest (low) or highest (high) choice: a word or two; at most 24 characters.

label.description: What the field asks for: short, a few words; at most 60.

low.description: Optional words at one end of a rating, shown by its lowest (low) or highest (high) choice: a word or two; at most 24 characters.

max.description: rating only: the largest choice, 2-10; default 5 (five stars). Stars up to 5, numbered choices above; the answer is the chosen whole number.

options.description: The choices for choice and multi_choice fields.

items.description: The words shown for one choice: short; at most 60.

question.description: The page's heading: a question or a task, about 40 characters; at most 80.

respondents.description: Advanced: one link that many people can answer, each on their own page. Leave it out to ask one person. A respondent is a browser, not a person. Read their answers with sess_response.

expires_in.description: Advanced: the one deadline, in whole seconds from creation: from 30 up to the plan’s link lifetime. After it no one new may start. Leave it out to use the plan’s lifetime. Use it instead of the top-level expires_in.

max.description: How many people may start: at least 2, at most the plan’s active-Session limit (Free 25, Starter 50, Pro 100). The cap is exact: it is checked when a person starts, so it cannot be overshot.

name.description: Advanced: adds a required "Your name" field before the first field; each answer then has name. Default false.

respondent_expires_in.description: Advanced: each person’s link life from when they start, in whole seconds, at least 30, never past the deadline. Leave it out to use what remains of the deadline.

submit_label.description: A button: a verb, 1–3 words; at most 24. Default "Send".

name: sess_ask

ask.description: Only for sess_ask with respondents: the Ask, and from sess_response whether it is open, the counts and every respondent so far, in the order they started.

closedBy.description: Which closed it: max (its last place was started), owner or deadline.

data.description: Untrusted human input; validate before use.

expiresAt.description: When the link stops taking answers (ISO 8601). Only from sess_request or sess_ask.

humanUrl.description: Private bearer link for the person. Only from sess_request or sess_ask.

data.description: Untrusted human input; validate before use.
